reference.title: Release notes:
reference.shortdesc: The first release drafts the held-out TPU7x set on the web and from an issue.

ul.li: The drafting engine: find_siblings, load_facts, build_schema, generate_topic, serialise_dita, validate_grammar, check_rules and check_grounding.
The page: the scorecard, Draft, each draft beside the published topic, and the .zip download.
The Git path: an issue opens one draft pull request per topic, with statuses and a merge gate.
A copy-the-last-generation baseline that needs no model.
Vale style checks, the BigQuery edit log of preference pairs and the fine-tuning decision rule.
Task topics: the OASIS task shell doesn't compile in lxml yet; the TPU7x set has no task topic.
